data_policy.payload_storage: encrypted minimized flat fact with an exact allowlist and keyed opaque partitions

migration_policy.evidence_boundary: counts only; current columns, constraints, normalized keys, immutable fact hashes, producer lineage, target counts, and watermarks remain unverified
migration_policy.strategy: additive v2 columns and v2 rows only after metadata readback; never rebuild, truncate, rename, or delete a nonempty table from this contract
migration_policy.legacy_selection: analytics_sync selects only ROW_SCHEMA_VERSION=2; null or other versions remain untouched
migration_policy.casefold_collision_rule: No proposed v2 column may case-insensitively collide with a documented v1 column. The v2 outbox state is SYNC_STATUS; checkpoint STATUS remains unchanged because that table has no documented collision.
required_migration_evidence: source row counts by table and environment
normalized-key count and digest with the normalization algorithm recorded
provider-version-fenced OUTBOX_KEY count and digest with duplicate and payload-conflict reports
Zoho Analytics import and independent readback counts and watermarks
legacy-row disposition and rollback or containment

acceptance_sequence.enforcement: operator release contract; not a runtime canary selector or an execution grant
acceptance_sequence.first_call_gate: first normal call must pass alert/inbox, Analytics import/readback, reconciled results/CRM summary and safe completion before another call; no synthetic cloud mode or direct success seeding
acceptance_sequence.pre_import_digest_scope: reviewed pre-import migration-preflight envelope, not completed import acceptance
pre_import_required: fresh exact Development identity, deployed artifact, source schemas and nullable-unique constraints
complete source inventory, normalized-key count/digest and algorithm, immutable fact hashes and ownership
provider-version-fenced OUTBOX_KEY count/digest and zero unresolved duplicate, payload or lineage conflicts
approved controlled-call worker-produced v2 evidence and independent immutable source readback
exact private target bindings, independent target schema/access/row-count prestate and distinct Connections
complete eligible-work and execution inventory, frozen competing producers and disabled schedules
legacy-row disposition, source preservation and independently verifiable containment
separate bounded controlled-call import authorization with confirmed non-charging Analytics/Catalyst allowance

controlled_call_import.required_scope: only the approved synthetic client/deployment and enumerated record types, including any derived daily metric
before_each_execution: independently read-back disabled mode and disabled Cron
complete pending/running execution inventory empty and all competing producers frozen
complete authoritative v2, batch and rollup-source inventory equals the pinned canary scope
exact row identities, ownership, hashes, watermarks, revision and fixed batch/rollup/poll settings
fresh per-phase packet within a valid finite allocation
controlled_call_import.execution_window: authorize exactly one serialized manual Job; correlate and reconcile its bounded terminal outcome, then restore/read back disabled before any next phase; an ambiguous submit, deadline or state immediately triggers containment without retry
controlled_call_import.allocation_consumption: queued/running status is not config-capture evidence; DisabledNoOp consumes its Job allocation without passing an import phase; drain/reconcile possible executions before another separately budgeted window
stop_on: unknown or unrelated v2 work, including future-due rows
controlled_call_import.on_completion_or_stop: restore disabled mode and approved containment; preserve claims, rows, provider job identities and all evidence; reconcile before another approved attempt

post_import_required: reference to the exact pre-import envelope digest and consumed controlled-call import authorization
actual import job identities and terminal accepted/rejected/total counts
independent target readback matching exact keys, ownership, immutable hashes and normalized UTC values
outbox/checkpoint/source reconciliation, monotonic watermarks and no unresolved earlier work
derived daily-metric accounting, unchanged retained legacy rows and restored containment
acceptance_sequence.complete_migration_acceptance: both phases together satisfy every required_migration_evidence item; a preflight digest, empty target or successful submission is not acceptance

tables.purpose: One monotonic, version-fenced synchronization watermark per environment, record type, client, and deployment partition.
Immutable minimized Analytics facts with durable claim, retry, import-job, readback, reconciliation, and completion state.

columns.purpose: Atomic provider identity plus normalized source-watermark fence; PAYLOAD_HASH independently binds the immutable canonical payload.
Non-PII bounded daily-rollup routing date; call rows bind to STARTED_AT UTC date.

provisioning_gates: Preserve the existing nonempty AnalyticsSyncCheckpoints and AnalyticsSyncOutbox tables and every other observed Analytics-supporting table until lineage is reconciled.

Read back every current API name, type, maximum length, mandatory flag, uniqueness constraint, encrypted-text audit consent, App User permission, row count, and producer/consumer before proposing additive columns.

Add only compatible physically nullable columns needed for ROW_SCHEMA_VERSION=2, then independently read them back; do not recreate, truncate, rename, or delete either table. Every logical v2 requirement is enforced by required_for_v2_rows plus runtime validation, not by rewriting nonempty legacy rows.

Packet A proved general nullable-unique behavior with multiple null rows and read back the retained OUTBOX_KEY contract exact, but did not prove the full 71-column outbox application schema. Fresh-read both Analytics tables and repeat the exact constraint check before activation; any drift blocks activation.

For every retained v2 row, normalize accepted UTC timestamps with new Date(value).toISOString(), recompute and verify OUTBOX_KEY and PAYLOAD_HASH, then compare counts and digests. Any duplicate OUTBOX_KEY, provider identity mapped to a different key, or same key and identity with different immutable ownership or payload blocks activation.
Do not bind analytics_sync until source/runtime parity and synthetic claim, retry, ambiguity, reconciliation, and environment-isolation tests pass.
Production is dark: the function returns DarkNoOp before SDK initialization or any Data Store or Analytics operation.
